attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Downgrading the pinned SDK version from 9.0.203 to 9.0.100 with rollForward latestMajor could still resolve to an older/different SDK on build machines lacking 9.0.203, risking subtle build/tooling inconsistencies even though it doesn't change runtime application code."}

reason: Downgrading the pinned SDK version from 9.0.203 to 9.0.100 with rollForward latestMajor could still resolve to an older/different SDK on build machines lacking 9.0.203, risking subtle build/tooling inconsistencies even though it doesn't change runtime application code.
